title: Gunslugs
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#856, 2026-11-01), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 2 of 5: it reaches the title screen and closes as soon as A is pressed to play, and its log ends with 'Failed loading libusb-1.0.dll: Module not found', the GOG copy. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Doesn't play in one report on an M1 with D3DMetal. It reaches the title screen and closes as soon as a game is started.

knownIssues.symptom: Closes as soon as A is pressed at the title screen to play (M1, D3DMetal, Wine 10 r28)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The log ends with 'Failed loading libusb-1.0.dll: Module not found' right after the game loads a native library of its own from its temp folder
